description:
The Feed is Stroom's way of compartmentalising data that has been ingested or
created by a Pipeline.
Ingested data must specify the Feed that it is destined for.

The Feed Document defines the character encoding for the data in the Feed, the type of data that will be received into it (e.g. `Raw Events`) and optionally a Volume Group to use for data storage.
The Feed Document can also control the ingest of data using its `Feed Status` property and
be used for viewing data that belonging to that feed.
